variants.title: Sidebar
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Make a high fidelity straight-on 16:10 desktop screenshot concept at approximately 2400x1500, filling the entire image. This is a customized macOS computer desktop inspired by end-4's modern rounded Linux shell, NOT a website, application dashboard, marketing page, mood board, laptop photograph or device frame. Reference image is ONLY visual inspiration for rounded expressive desktop controls, not an edit target. The user's chosen colors are saturated SCARLET dominant and TEAL secondary: scarlet #FF493D, deep scarlet #A91F2E, teal #2DD4BF, charcoal #17191D and #262A30, warm-white #F3F0EA. Scarlet must be visibly the dominant chromatic color in wallpaper and selected controls; teal is about one quarter of the color emphasis, never competing equally. Avoid pastel lavender, olive, pink or orange-dominant palettes. Authentic computer proportions: a small top status bar, realistic app window chrome and macOS traffic lights, crisp readable UI type similar to SF Pro, monospace for terminal/code only, beautiful wallpaper visible around separate application windows. Scene uses Ghostty terminal with a few plausible shell lines in ~/.dotfiles, a code editor showing a short Nix theme configuration, a small browser window with plain documentation, and desktop-level music/audio controls. All data illustrative, no claims about running installations. The focus is whole-computer atmosphere, surfaces, spatial composition, typography and small desktop utilities. No giant product headings, analytics charts, tasks dashboard, fake telemetry, explanatory annotations, numbered callouts, labels outside the desktop, or excessive tiny widgets. Wallpaper must be beautiful authored imagery, not a generic web hero gradient. Readable text, elegant consistent line icons. Deliberately visible control center as a showcase state. Clean matte dark working surfaces, fine teal secondary details, soft offset shadows, realistic restrained blur only behind translucent desktop panels. Three macOS window buttons at correct tiny scale.
VARIATION A — SIDEBAR. Most faithful to end-4 spatial character. A slim vertical charcoal workspace/app rail on the far left with a scarlet selected capsule. A dense but serene tiled working arrangement in middle-left: editor large above, Ghostty small below, documentation browser narrow beside editor. A tall rounded charcoal control-center pane on right, about 24% screen width, with generously shaped vivid scarlet Wi-Fi and Bluetooth controls, a teal volume slider, one music section with red photographic album art, and a small compact calendar. A subtle wide clock at top center, no large time on wallpaper. Broad curved red sculptural fabric folds as wallpaper, mostly black with one large vivid scarlet arc visible in the top-left and gaps; sophisticated abstract studio photograph, no pattern grid. Consistent 18px window corner radius, controlled generous panel padding, rich scarlet active controls. Show a believable lived-in Mac work session at calm density. All elements fit comfortably without touching screen edges.

VARIATION B — FLOATING. Different composition: native-feeling narrow full-width dark macOS top bar, detached rounded workspace capsules near its left. No vertical sidebar and no always-open tall right panel. Large amount of wallpaper is visible (at least 45%): a cinematic close-up photograph of flowing scarlet translucent glass ribbons against deep charcoal, with one tiny cool teal reflected edge. Place a large active code-editor window slightly left of center, Ghostty overlapping its lower-left edge, a small documentation browser behind on the right. Put two separate floating widgets near lower right: a compact richly scarlet music card with square album cover and a charcoal rounded audio quick-control popup with teal slider, generous spacing between. An open modest rounded launcher at upper right contains only three compact results 'Terminal', 'Change theme', 'Capture region', selected first result rich scarlet. Important: each is a separate computer window or desktop widget, not a giant enclosing application. Rounded 22px panels, softer shadows and restrained translucency. Wallpaper and active selected controls establish scarlet dominance; otherwise quiet gray reading surfaces. Modern relaxed composition, spacious and personal, avoid template dashboards.
